newsitem.title: USA: Royale to buy 10 Excel properties.
newsitem.headline: Royale to buy 10 Excel properties.

text.p: Royale Investments Inc said Friday it had signed an agreement to acquire 10 properties from Excel Realty Trust Inc for about $19 million.
The properties are in Alabama, Georgia, South Carolina, Pennsylvania and Illinois.
Eight of the properties are leased to Kroger Co and operated as grocery stores under various names. The other two sites are leased to SuperX Drugs Corp.
The acquisition will expand Royale's holdings to 17 properties in nine states, all 100 percent leased, the company said.

"This acquisition is the next step in Royale's strategic growth plan and will nearly double the size of the company to $45 million while also providing greater geographic and credit diversity," said Vernon Beck, chief executive of Royale.
Royale is a real estate investment trust.
